capital.evidence_quote: Paramaribo is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Suriname

currency.evidence_quote: The Surinamese Dollar (SRD) is the official currency of the Republic of Suriname

timezone.evidence_quote: Suriname Time operates year-round on UTC-3 without daylight saving time adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage is 127V/220V dual voltage 60 Hz across Paramaribo

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The operating frequency of the electrical power grid is 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: European standard Type C round two-pin and Schuko Type F sockets are standard across Suriname

police.evidence_quote: Dial 115 for emergency police assistance throughout Suriname

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 112 or 113 for AZP emergency ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 110 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 115 coordinates central emergency dispatch in Suriname

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Police headquarters in Paramaribo handles tourist safety inquiries at +597 404022

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Surinam genel olarak huzurludur; Paramaribo'da gece saatlerinde standart dikkat, yağmur ormanı turlarında ise lisanslı rehberler önerilir.
advisory_headline.en: Suriname is generally peaceful; exercise normal precautions, and hire licensed guides for Amazon interior tours.
advisory_headline.de: Suriname ist weitgehend friedlich; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen, für Dschungeltouren lizenzierte Führer nutzen.
advisory_headline.ru: Суринам в целом безопасен; соблюдайте стандартные правила и нанимайте лицензированных гидов в джунгли.
advisory_headline.es: Surinam es generalmente tranquilo; aplican precauciones normales y guías autorizados en la selva.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Suriname reach approximately 28.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 45.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Telesur and Digicel provide 4G SIMs at Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport (PBM). All tourists must pay the mandatory online Entry Fee ($25/€25) at suriname.vfsevisa.com before boarding flights.

sources.title: Suriname VFS E-Visa and Entry Fee Portal

esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Tourists must obtain the official digital Entry Fee voucher prior to traveling to Suriname

source.title: Ministry of Transport, Communication and Tourism

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 48%), Hinduism (approx. 22%), and Islam (approx. 14%) reflecting Afro-Surinamese, Hindustani, and Javanese pluralism

sources.title: Algemeen Bureau voor de Statistiek (ABS) Suriname

religion.evidence_quote: Suriname is famously celebrated for having a synagogue and a mosque standing side-by-side on Keizerstraat in Paramaribo

festivals.value: Phagwa (Holi festival celebrated by all ethnicities), Keti Koti (Emancipation Day on July 1), Surifest Owru Yari (New Year's Eve street party)
festivals.evidence_quote: Owru Yari street celebrations and Pagara fireworks explosions on Dec 31 draw international revelers

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Dutch is the official administrative language; Sranan Tongo is spoken universally as a lingua franca. Yellow fever vaccination is mandatory if arriving from endemic countries. Do not photograph military buildings or river border posts.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Proof of yellow fever vaccination is required for entry into Suriname under health ministry protocols

tipping.value: Tipping 10% is customary in sit-down restaurants in Paramaribo. Rounding up taxi fares to the nearest 10-20 SRD is standard practice.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% tip is standard in restaurants and hospitality services
